title: The Car Is On Fire! Fire Prevention Week on Kadena 2026
description: U.S. Air Force firefighters assigned to the 18th Civil Engineer Squadron participate in a live fire demonstration for Fire Prevention Week at Kadena Air Base, Okinawa, Japan, Oct. 8, 2026. The 18th CES hosted multiple events as part of the annual observance aimed at raising awareness of fire safety and educating base personnel to include dependent children. (U.S. Navy video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Tyler Jackson)
keywords: live-fire exercise, AFN Okinawa, Fire Prevention Awareness Month, AFN, Okinawa
